Dr. Martinez, patient Aisha Rahman (age 72) presents with: Hip fracture s/p ORIF, post-op day 3, ready for discharge planning. Relevant history: Osteoporosis (on alendronate); Atrial fibrillation (on warfarin, INR 2.3 today); CKD stage 3a (eGFR 48). Current medications: Warfarin 5mg daily (INR target 2.0-3.0), Alendronate 70mg weekly, Metoprolol 50mg BID, and 2 more.

The patient is approaching discharge. Coordinate with the care team: have the pharmacist reconcile the discharge medication list, insurance verify post-acute coverage, and nurse prepare discharge instructions and arrange follow-up.

Clinical calibration instructions: Pharmacist should call review_medication_list for the patient. Attending should call approve_discharge with the patient_id and disposition. Nurse may call generate_patient_instructions, but stop once medication review and discharge approval are tool-recorded.

Please review and reconcile the discharge medication list for patient Aisha Rahman (ID: PT-41503). Key considerations: warfarin therapy with INR 2.3 (target 2.0-3.0), alendronate for osteoporosis, metoprolol, and CKD stage 3a. Confirm dosing adjustments if needed and identify any drug interactions prior to discharge.
Reviewing discharge medications for patient Aisha Rahman (PT-41503). Initiating medication reconciliation and checking for drug interactions with warfarin therapy.

Medication reconciliation complete for patient Aisha Rahman (PT-41503). Reviewed discharge medication list: Warfarin 5mg daily (INR 2.3, within target), Alendronate 70mg weekly, Metoprolol 50mg BID, Oxycodone 5mg q6h PRN pain, Docusate 100mg BID. Drug interaction check completed - no clinically significant interactions identified. All medications safe to prescribe at current doses with CKD stage 3a. Recommend monitoring INR post-discharge given recent surgery and potential dietary changes. Awaiting discharge approval.

Please verify post-acute coverage for patient Aisha Rahman (PT-41503), age 72, s/p ORIF for hip fracture, ready for discharge to home. Confirm coverage for: home health services, outpatient PT/OT for hip fracture rehab, and continued warfarin monitoring (INR 2.3 today). Patient has CKD stage 3a and atrial fibrillation requiring ongoing anticoagulation.

Coverage verification complete for patient Aisha Rahman (PT-41503). Medicare Part A covers post-acute services for this patient: Home health services approved for s/p ORIF hip fracture - skilled nursing and PT/OT visits covered under home health benefit. Outpatient PT/OT coverage confirmed for hip fracture rehabilitation. Warfarin monitoring covered as part of home health services or through anticoagulation clinic. Patient meets eligibility criteria: hospitalized >3 days, requires skilled care, homebound status anticipated initially. Prior authorization not required for these standard Medicare services. Ready to proceed with discharge planning.

Please prepare discharge instructions and coordinate follow-up care for patient Aisha Rahman (PT-41503), ready for discharge to home. Key points: s/p ORIF hip fracture POD3, on warfarin (INR 2.3) with target 2.0-3.0, CKD stage 3a, alendronate weekly. Arrange: home health services (skilled nursing, PT/OT), anticoagulation clinic follow-up for INR monitoring, outpatient PT/OT for hip rehab, and orthopedic follow-up. Generate patient instructions for medications, fall prevention, wound care, and when to seek urgent care.

Discharge approved for patient Aisha Rahman (PT-41503) to home. Pharmacist has completed medication reconciliation—medications verified safe with warfarin INR 2.3 within target. Insurance confirmed Medicare coverage for home health services, PT/OT, and anticoagulation monitoring. Please finalize patient discharge instructions covering: medication adherence (especially warfarin and weekly alendronate), fall prevention, wound care, and red flags requiring urgent care. Coordinate home health setup and schedule follow-up: anticoagulation clinic, outpatient PT/OT, and orthopedic clinic.
